blocks.text: Do this in Gmail on a computer, or in Chrome's desktop site. The Gmail app has no forwarding settings.

blocks.title: Add your address in Gmail
blocks.body: Copy your address from the app. In the Gmail where VTOP's mail arrives, open Settings → See all settings → Forwarding and POP/IMAP, tap Add a forwarding address, paste it, then Next → Proceed → OK. On a phone, use Chrome with ⋮ → Desktop site.

blocks.title: Confirm it
blocks.body: Gmail now shows Verify next to your address. Its confirmation mail comes to the app, not your inbox: tap Check, then Confirm in Gmail, or type the code into Gmail's Verify box. Leave "Disable forwarding" selected, so only the filter forwards mail.

blocks.title: Reload Gmail
blocks.body: After confirming, reload the Gmail page before you make the filter. Without a reload, the filter has no address to forward to and shows only Add forwarding address, like this.

callout.text: Reload first, or Gmail won't list your address in the filter.

blocks.caption: Before reloading: no address to pick

blocks.title: Create the filter
blocks.body: Open Filters and Blocked Addresses → Create a new filter. Put {sender} in From, then tap Create filter.

blocks.title: Forward it to your address
blocks.body: Tick Forward it to and pick your address. Mark as read keeps the OTP mails out of your unread count. Then tap Create filter.

blocks.title: Done
blocks.body: The filter shows in the list. Back in the app, tap Check: the next VTOP OTP fills in by itself. Mail sent before the filter isn't forwarded.
